# Store #4172 — Operations

## Store hours (routing fact — associates ask Marc constantly)
- **Mon–Fri:** 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM.
- **Saturday:** opens **8:00 AM**, closes 9:00 PM. (Saturday is the earliest open of the week.)
- **Sunday:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM.
- Holiday hours are set by district each season and posted separately.

## Opening procedure
- Opening manager arrives **60 minutes** before doors (8:00 AM weekdays, 7:00 AM Saturdays).
- Pull the safe, count and assign register tills, verify the overnight alarm log, walk the floor for
  safety/recovery, brief the opening team at the **morning huddle** (see below), unlock at open.

## Closing procedure
- **Nightly cash close-out** must be **dual-verified** by the closing manager and a second keyholder, and
  the safe reconciled by **9:45 PM**. Deposit is dropped at the bank the next morning by **9:00 AM**.
- Closing team recovers the floor, completes go-backs, sets alarm, badges out together (no one alone at close).

## Staffing model
- **Two Assistant Managers** ([Jordan Alvarez](../people/jordan-alvarez.md) — Operations;
  [Tanya Brooks](../people/tanya-brooks.md) — Sales & Service) split the open/close manager-on-duty rotation
  with Marc. Currently short one AM since [Kyle Bennett](../people/kyle-bennett.md) left, so coverage is tight.
- **Department leads** own a zone (footwear, apparel, camp/hike, front-end) and their planograms.
- **Hourly associates** are scheduled to traffic; the schedule posts **10 days out** and is built by the AMs.
- Payroll is budgeted as a **% of planned sales**; overtime needs SM approval.

## Shrink & audit process
- **Cycle counts:** high-theft categories counted **every Tuesday**; full physical inventory **twice a year
  (January and July)**.
- **Shrink** = the gap between book inventory and counted inventory (theft, damage, error, paperwork).
  Store target is **≤ 1.4% of sales**; #4172 ran **1.9%** at the last audit — over target.
- LP ([Victor Hultgren](../people/victor-hultgren.md)) reviews exception reports (refunds, voids, no-sales)
  and runs quarterly store audits. See [Shrink Reduction Plan](../projects/shrink-reduction-plan.md).

## Key metrics / KPIs (what the DM asks about)
- **Comp sales** (comparable-store sales vs. same period last year) — plan is **+4%**.
- **ADS** — average daily sales.
- **Conversion** — % of visitors who buy (target ~22%).
- **UPT** — units per transaction (target **2.3**).
- **Summit Rewards sign-up rate** — target **30%** of transactions.
- **Shrink %** — target ≤ 1.4%.
- **NPS / mystery shop** — customer experience scores; NPS target **72**.
